utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, book club? I heard they’re picking something lively this month, so you may want to join before the good spots are spoken for.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Book club, right? Are they actually picking something lively this month?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s what I heard, yes - something a little lively, not a heavy slog. I’d ask around soon, though, because the popular ones always fill up fast.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can join the book club plan. Let me know when Noah wants to meet.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good, Vik. How about next Tuesday evening?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Next Tuesday evening works for me.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can make it to book club. What time are we meeting?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Seven o'clock at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, I’ll be there at seven.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ve been meaning to ask about the book club. What are you all reading next?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re starting with a mystery novel this month, then something lighter after that.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds promising. Mystery first, then something lighter is a good mix.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely, I can do after-school on Tuesdays or Thursdays if that helps the book club meet.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, Tuesdays sound perfect for the book club. I’ll circle that back to everyone and we can pick the best one.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, Tuesday works for me. Thanks for coordinating it with everyone.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds fine by me. Let’s keep it simple and decide on a time for the next meeting.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: How about Tuesday evening at my place? I might need a reminder, but I can write it down this time.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Tuesday evening at your place works for me. I’ll put a reminder on my calendar and bring the book list.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You should come by the book club this week, Pia — I think you’d like the group.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I might be able to make it, but I’d need to know the time and whether there’s parking first.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It’s Thursday at 7, and there’s street parking right by the hall.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the book club’s meeting got moved, but I’m not sure to when. Have you heard anything more from Rosa?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, it’s been moved to Thursday evening at the community center. I’ll send the details around so everyone has them.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, I’ll watch for the details from Rosa.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Mara, could you remind me which book the club is discussing this week?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It’s The Traveling Library this week, if I remember right.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, I’ll note The Traveling Library for this week.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I might skip book club this week, but I hope you both have a good discussion.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: No worries, we'll catch you next time and fill you in.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. I appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I heard the book club is picking a good one this month. Need me to bring anything over?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Just yourself, if you’re coming. What book are we reading?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Oh, right, you asked for one book. I think they said it’s a mystery this month, but I’ll check and let you know before I show up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, the book club is meeting at my place this week — I’ve got the address written down if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, just send me the address.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sure — I’ll send it over now.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring my folding chairs if the book club needs them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That would be helpful, thanks. I can bring the books and you can bring the chairs.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, I’ll bring the chairs.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can come, but I need to know the time and where we're meeting so I can plan the bus.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, but can you confirm the time and the meeting place?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I still need the time and the meeting place before I can say yes.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I heard the book club’s meeting has a really good pick this month. Want me to loop you in with the group chat?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sure, count me in.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, I’ll add you to the group chat and send the meeting details.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure, I can bring a couple of flyers and the signup sheet if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, thanks. I’ll be there a bit late, but I can help hand those out when I get in.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, that’ll help a lot. I’ll set those aside for you and see you there.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the book club’s picking a new novel this week. I’m hoping they choose something with a good mystery in it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I hope they do too. A good mystery would give us something to talk about all week.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Definitely, a mystery gives everyone something to puzzle over. I’ll be curious to see what they pick.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, book club? I skimmed the details, but I can still make it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, then I’ll count you in. We start at seven, and I’ll save you a seat.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, see you at seven.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I can help with the book club. What are you reading this month?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We’re reading *The Bell Jar* this month.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Oh, that’s a good one. I’d love to hear what you think of it after your meeting.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the book club? You should come this week, Nell - I think you'd really like this month's pick.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I hadn't heard about this month's pick. I might come by if I can swing it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You should come by if you can, Nell. I’ll make sure you get the details before the week’s out.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m pretty sure the book club meets at the library this week.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: If it is, I’ll meet you there on time.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I’ll meet you at the library then.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are we meeting at the library or at your place?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Let's meet at the library so we have a quiet place.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, what time are we meeting there?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the book club is picking a new novel next week. I’ll ask around and see what people are leaning toward.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’d like that. I always mix up the titles, so I’m glad someone’s keeping track.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I know the feeling. I’ll bring the title and maybe a short list so we can all keep it straight.
